exact_original_statement: Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ and $D'\subset\mathbb R^{d'}$ be bounded domains. Let $A$ and $U$ be real Banach function spaces on $D$ and $D'$ that embed continuously into $C(\bar D)$ and $C(\bar D')$, respectively. Let $\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\sigma_3:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous, and let $G:A\to U$ be any $N$-layer neural operator in the function-space class defined by the neural-operator construction. Then compatible finite-dimensional Riemann-sum realizations of $G$, using the same parameters at each refinement, converge to $G$ uniformly on every compact input set in the output-space norm $U$.
